TL;DR

Community, by design

An app for a closer-knit camp community, informed by my camp operations leadership. The work connects product design, design systems and the practical needs of camp life.

My role
Product design · design systems

Background

Design grounded in camp life

The project brings community-building and coordination into the app experience. Operational leadership provides context for the everyday needs of the people living and working together.
